# `band_outer`

the pointwise outer product z z^H of a recording's band analytic signal at the sensors.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run band_outer --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run band_outer --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run measure --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --set analytic_cross_spectrum_tiles --recording rest --band "8-12 Hz" --all
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `z` | field analytic signal, chain band_analytic, chain_parameters {"recording": "{recording}", "band": "$band", "bands": "$bands", "channels": "$channels", "shape": "$shape", "halo": "$halo"} (composed in: the band's analytic signal) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `bands` | `--bands` | none | - |  | the band SET by name (a member per band). Exactly one of band, bands |
| `band` | `--band` | none | Hz |  | ONE band as a quantity ("8-12 Hz"). Exactly one of band, bands |
| `channels` | `--channels` | none | - |  | a stored cross-spectrum's name: the analytic signal is made on ITS channels only; null: every channel of the recording |
| `shape` | `--shape` | `morlet` | - | morlet, meyer, power_partition | the band filter: morlet \| meyer \| power_partition |
| `halo` | `--halo` | `8.0` | s |  | the context read on each side of a chunk for the filter |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.field_form`](../nodes.md) | x=z | form=outer | zz |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `zz` | kind field, kind_name outer product, name {recording}_band_outer, on recording.manifold.0, derived_from recording |

## Notes from the definition

```text
A FIELD CHAIN (`kind: chain`): the OUTER PRODUCT of a band's analytic signal at the sensors, z z^H per sample (the general A M A^H algebra, its own pointwise form `outer`): field<channels x channels x T; complex>.
Composes `band_analytic` then the form `outer` (`field.form`). Composed into `measure` (preset analytic_cross_spectrum_tiles) the sum over a time tile of z z^H is the tile's cross-spectrum.

Not materialised by default: a z z^H per sample is channels^2 values a sample; run alone it is for small checks only.

  nxr-neuro run measure --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --set analytic_cross_spectrum_tiles --recording rest --band "8-12 Hz" --all
```
